column1: # THE AMPLIFIER's rulers (item 11): two things the liquidity spiral sets that no dial reads.
# profile     volatility clustering as the FULL autocorrelation profile of |r| (demeaned,
#             full-sample denominator -- `uni.apps.MarketSim.autocorrAbs`, the function the model
#             grades itself with) at lags 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 60, 120, with the window's annual
#             volatility and daily kurtosis (Pearson, 3 = normal) as context.  CRSP = Ken French
#             F-F_Research_Data_Factors_daily (202606 vintage), Mkt-RF + RF, the century (w1926),
#             post-war (w1954) and QQQ's own span (w1999); SPY and QQQ = Yahoo adjusted close log
#             returns; NDX = the Nasdaq-100 index close, a price index.  The shipped `clustering
#             lag 1` / `lag 20` anchors are this file's CRSP w1926 ac1 / ac20 rows.
# elasticity  crash count against volatility across the fresh-start cross-section: the w2001
#             instruments of yahoo-2026-08-24.tsv on ONE window opening at the 2007-10-09 high
#             near a high) through 2026-08-20, each instrument's 15%+ drawdown episodes per century
#             on `ddEpisodes`' definition and its annual volatility; `logSlope` is the OLS slope of
#             log(crashes per century) on log(annVol) -- the model's own `depth` sweep reads ~1.8
#             and its two recipes 1.44 -- and `SPY-QQQ own` the slope between the two anchor sets'
